get.summary: Gets a site by id.
get.description: Returns the site aggregate including its localized display names.

put.description: Replaces default culture, allowed cultures, domains, theme and the activation flag.

delete.description: Marks the site as deleted (tombstone); it stops appearing in standard queries.

post.description: Creates a site within the current tenant. Slug must be unique per tenant.

get.summary: Returns a paged, filterable list of SiteListItemResponse from Site.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against Site using the Granit query engine and projects each row to SiteListItemResponse. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult<SiteListItemResponse> by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult<SiteListItemResponse> with the same projection applied to the items inside each group.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

put.summary: Designates the page served at the site root path '/'.
put.description: Promotes an existing, non-root page of this site to the homepage: its public per-culture path becomes '/' (it stops resolving at its own slug). Any previously designated homepage reverts to its structural slug path. Returns 404 if the site or page does not exist, 400 if the page belongs to another site or is the technical site root.

delete.description: Removes the page designated at '/'; the previously designated page reverts to its slug path and '/' stops resolving. Returns 404 if the site does not exist.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Site (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Site: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

post.summary: Creates a non-root page under an existing parent.
post.description: Inherits site and tenant from the parent; the resulting StructurePath is parent.Path + '/' + SlugSegment.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Page (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Page: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

get.summary: Resolves a published page by per-culture path.
get.description: Public SSR contract consumed by the Next.js renderer. Returns the published per-culture content for the page at the given path. Drafts and archived-only pages return 404. The site is taken from the X-Granit-Site header.

get.summary: Returns the structural page tree for the current site.
get.description: Flat depth-first list of nodes ordered by structure path. Site root included.

get.summary: Returns the page aggregate by id.
get.description: Includes the page's per-culture translations.

put.summary: Renames the page's culture-invariant slug segment.
put.description: Recomputes the page's own StructurePath; descendants are rewritten in the same transaction.

delete.description: Marks the page as soft-deleted so it no longer appears in tree or routing queries. The site root page cannot be deleted. Returns 404 if the page does not exist.

post.summary: Reparents the page under a different parent in the same site.
post.description: Moves the page to a new parent within the same site, rewriting StructurePath for the page and all its descendants. Returns 400 if the target parent is a descendant of the page being moved (cycle guard) or belongs to a different site.

put.summary: Upserts the per-culture URL slug and title.
put.description: Creates or replaces the URL slug and title for the given culture, then rebuilds the cached per-culture Path for the page and its descendants. Returns 404 if the page does not exist.

put.summary: Persists the editor's working block tree for a culture.
put.description: Idempotent on the page's current draft; materialises a new draft after a publish. Two editors saving the same culture in parallel collide loudly with a 409 carrying PageDraftConflictResponse — the client should refetch the current draft state and reconcile in-editor.

get.summary: Lists every version of a page in chronological order.
get.description: Returns all draft, published, and archived versions for the page, ordered oldest-first. Each entry carries the lifecycle status and publish timestamp. Returns 404 if the page does not exist.

post.summary: Promotes the page's current draft to Published.
post.description: Archives the previously published version (if any), then publishes the draft.
Moves the currently published version to the Archived state, effectively taking the page offline. Returns 409 if the page has no currently published version.

post.summary: Creates a fresh draft cloning a target snapshot's per-culture content.
post.description: History (target itself) is left untouched. Refused while an active draft already exists.

post.summary: Mints a signed preview token for a page draft.
post.description: Issues an opaque, expiring HMAC-signed token granting the renderer anonymous access to the page's draft content for a single culture. Requires Cms.Pages.Manage.

post.summary: Records or refreshes the caller's presence in the page-editing room.
post.description: Idempotent — calling on an already-active participant just refreshes the timestamp. The user id is resolved from the authenticated principal.

delete.summary: Removes the caller from the page-editing room.
delete.description: Called by the editor on tab close so the room reflects the truth immediately rather than waiting for the heartbeat TTL to expire.

get.summary: Lists the editors currently in the page-editing room.
get.description: Ordered freshest first. Stale entries (older than the configured threshold) are filtered at read time.

get.summary: Full-text search across every published page in the tenant.
get.description: Routes the query through ISearchService<Guid, Guid> — backend-agnostic, the consumer wires either Granit.Indexing.EntityFrameworkCore (Postgres tsvector) or Granit.Indexing.Elasticsearch. Hits are projected to PageSearchHitResponse using the requested culture's title + path; the page translation falls back to the first available culture when the requested one has no translation.

get.summary: Public-site search — anonymous, scoped to the current site.
get.description: Same engine as the admin endpoint, but post-filtered by the X-Granit-Site header so a site only returns its own pages. Drafts are excluded by construction: the indexer only ingests published versions.

get.summary: Resolves a preview token into the corresponding draft content.
get.description: Anonymous, token-gated. The Next.js renderer calls this endpoint with the token issued by the mint endpoint; the server validates the token signature and expiry and returns the draft per-culture content.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use token from a confirmation/reset email link.

get.summary: Gets a menu by id.
get.description: Returns the stored menu with its unresolved item tree.

put.summary: Updates a menu's title and replaces its item tree.
put.description: Renames the menu and swaps the whole item tree (copy-on-write).

delete.description: Marks the menu as deleted (tombstone); its key becomes reusable.

post.description: Creates a menu for a site. Key must be kebab-case and unique within the site.

get.description: Public contract consumed by the renderer: returns the menu with Page targets resolved to their live per-culture path and hidden items pruned. Anonymous.

get.summary: Gets a release by id.
get.description: Returns the release including its schedule and actions.

put.description: Changes the release name. Rejected once the release has executed.

post.description: Creates a Draft release for a site within the current tenant.

post.summary: Adds a publish/unpublish action to a release.
post.description: Targets a content item by content type, id and optional culture.

delete.summary: Removes an action from a release.
delete.description: Removes the action by id. Rejected once the release has executed.

post.description: Sets a wall-clock time and IANA time zone; the release becomes Ready.
Clears the schedule and returns the release to Draft.
Runs every action (publish/unpublish) immediately and returns the outcome.

get.summary: Lists the available blocks and their editor-agnostic field model.
get.description: Returns every registered block grouped by editorial category, each with its field model derived by convention from its schema (semantic field kinds, not editor widgets), its version, render side and source module. The editor integration maps the field kinds to its own widgets.

get.summary: Public SSR contract: lists the available blocks and their field model.
get.description: Anonymous, read-only projection of the runtime block registry — the same payload as the admin catalog, exposed for the public SSR renderer to build its render config without authentication. Published/runtime registry only; no admin-only fields.

post.summary: Resolves the live data for a data-bound block.
post.description: Public SSR contract consumed by the renderer: given a block's data-source key + query, returns the resolved data and the content keys it consumed (surrogate cache tags). Anonymous; published content only.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence.
